domains.name: Understanding the foundations of AI governance
Understanding how laws, standards and frameworks apply to AI
Understanding how to govern AI development
Understanding how to govern AI deployment and use

targetScores.mock1: >=60% overall and >=55% on Domains III and IV (else book 10 Nov and redo the course lessons for III/IV)
targetScores.mock2: >=70% overall, no domain <65% (>=75% counts toward the booking rule)
targetScores.bookingRule: Mocks #2 and #3 (two consecutive) >=75% with no domain <65-70% AND IAPP official >=70-75%

weeks.theme: Course kick-off, diagnostic, Domain I (foundations) and II.A-II.B (privacy and other laws)

tasks.title: Read the AIGP BoK v2.1 PDF: all four domains' competencies and performance indicators; tag each line Strong / Partial / Weak against your BlueDot background
Read the IAPP Candidate Handbook PDF: scheduling, rescheduling/cancellation cut-offs, ID rules, OnVUE requirements. Check Pearson VUE seats for Tue 27 Oct
Request the free IAPP AIGP study guide (form); check it shows the 4-domain structure
AI Career Pro FREE trial: course intro + Domain I.A lessons (what AI is, AI types, risks and harms). BlueDot-covered, so watch at 1.5x
Watch 'AIGP v2.1 Full Course Update Explained' (what changed in v2.1)
Diagnostic part 1: AI Career Pro free practice exam, untimed; mark every guess
Diagnostic part 2: IAPP free study guide sample questions
Start a gap log: tag every miss and guess by BoK competency; rank the four domains weakest to strongest
Buy the AI Career Pro AIGP Exam Prep course ($99) if the trial lessons and questions felt IAPP-like (else see the plan's budget section for the alternative)
Set up your Anki deck; add the first 15 cards from diagnostic misses
Course: Domain I.B lessons (roles and responsibilities, governance committees, cross-functional collaboration, AI literacy and training)
Course: Domain I.B quiz questions; add every miss to Anki
Read EU AI Act Article 4 (AI literacy duty)
Lab 1 (NovaPay): sketch NovaPay's AI governance structure: committee, owners, RACI for approving a new AI use case
Course: Domain I.C lessons (policies and procedures across the AI lifecycle)
Course: Domain I.C quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Lab 2 (NovaPay): draft a 1-page AI use policy + an AI inventory template (fields: owner, purpose, data, vendor, risk tier, status)
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook GOVERN 1-6 and compare with your Lab 1-2 drafts
Listen: AIGP Audio Course Ep. 11, privacy, security, data-governance and IP policies for AI (I.C.2)
Rest day: no study
Course: Domain II.A lessons (privacy and data protection law applied to AI)
Course: Domain II.A quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read GDPR Article 22 (automated individual decision-making, incl. profiling)
Read GDPR Article 35 (DPIA: when required, minimum contents); you'll use it in Lab 6
Anki: GDPR articles that matter for AI (5, 6, 13, 22, 35) in one line each
Read GDPR Articles 5 and 6 (principles, lawful bases) for AI training data
Course: Domain II.B lessons (IP, anti-discrimination, consumer protection, product liability)
Course: Domain II.B quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read FTC 'Operation AI Comply' (Section 5 deception/unfairness applied to AI claims)
Read NYC DCWP page on Local Law 144 (AEDT bias audits, candidate notice)
Week 1 recap: Anki review + teach-back: explain Domain I out loud in 5 minutes (voice memo), then check against your notes
Read Veronica Lin's 'How I passed the AIGP exam' (what worked, what didn't)

weeks.theme: Course: II.C-II.D (EU AI Act, standards) and III.A-III.C (governing development), plus EU AI Act lab

tasks.title: Course: Domain II.C lessons (EU AI Act and other AI-specific laws)
Course: Domain II.C quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read the EU AI Act high-level summary: risk tiers, provider vs deployer duties, GPAI
Read EU AI Act Article 5 (the prohibited practices)
Course: Domain II.D lessons (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and 42005, OECD, other frameworks)
Course: Domain II.D quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read the AIRC AI RMF Core page: Govern/Map/Measure/Manage and their category IDs
Anki: NIST functions + categories; ISO 42001 (management system) vs 42005 (impact assessment)
Watch 'NIST AI RMF deep dive: GOVERN vs MAP vs MEASURE vs MANAGE'
Course: Domain III.A lessons (governing design and build: use-case intake, impact assessment, requirements)
Course: Domain III.A quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook MAP 1-5 (the design-stage checklist); skim, note 5 actions NovaPay should take
Read Model Cards for Model Reporting (Mitchell et al.): the model-card sections

Lab 3 (NovaPay): run the EU AI Act Compliance Checker on 5 NovaPay systems (credit scoring, CV screening, customer chatbot, fraud detection, AI-generated marketing video); record the risk tier and NovaPay's role for each
Check your Lab 3 answers against EU AI Act Article 6 (high-risk classification, incl. Art 6(3) derogation) and Annex III
Read EU AI Act Article 3 definitions (provider, deployer, importer, distributor) and fix any role you got wrong in Lab 3
Week 2 recap: Anki review + drill 20 OpenExamPrep questions (Domains I-II)
Watch 'AIGP How They Passed - July 2026' (v2.1-era candidate panel)
Rest day: no study
Course: Domain III.B lessons (data governance, training and testing, bias and fairness)
Course: Domain III.B quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read EU AI Act Article 10 (data and data governance)
Lab 4 (NovaPay): answer 10 key questions from Datasheets for Datasets for NovaPay's credit-scoring training data
Course: Domain III.C lessons (testing, release readiness, monitoring and maintenance during development)
Course: Domain III.C quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook MEASURE 1-4 (metrics, TEVV, bias, feedback); skim the eval parts you know from BlueDot
Anki: Domain III lifecycle stages and the artefact produced at each (intake form, impact assessment, datasheet, model card, test report)
Read OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025: LLM01-LLM10 titles + mitigations

weeks.theme: Course: IV.A-IV.C (governing deployment), Mock #1, book the exam, EU AI Act high-risk deep dive

tasks.title: Course: Domain IV.A lessons (deciding whether and how to deploy, incl. agentic AI)
Course: Domain IV.A quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read Singapore Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI: agent risks and controls sections
Read EU AI Act Article 26 (obligations of deployers of high-risk AI)
Course: Domain IV.B lessons (assessments, third-party/vendor due diligence, contracts)
Course: Domain IV.B quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read IAPP: 'EU model contractual clauses for AI procurement: a practical guide'
Lab 5 (NovaPay): write a 12-question vendor due-diligence questionnaire for buying a third-party CV-screening tool
Course: Domain IV.C lessons (post-deployment monitoring, incidents, decommissioning)
Course: Domain IV.C quiz questions; add misses to Anki
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook MANAGE 1-4 (risk response, third-party risk, monitoring, incident communication); skim
Anki: deployer duties, vendor contract terms, incident steps
FULL MOCK #1: AI Career Pro Mock 1, 100 Qs, timed 165 min, no notes (target >=60% overall, >=55% on III and IV)
Score Mock #1 by domain; update the gap log; apply the decision rule (keep 27 Oct or move to 10 Nov?)
Rest day: no study

BOOK THE EXAM (gated on Mock #1): >=60% and >=55% on III/IV -> book Tue 27 Oct 2026; otherwise book fallback Tue 10 Nov 2026. Book via the IAPP AIGP page, then Pearson VUE (morning slot, or take the afternoon off)
Review every Mock #1 item (right and wrong): write why each distractor is wrong
Anki: a card for every Mock #1 miss
Read EU AI Act Chapter III Section 2 (Arts 8-15 high-risk requirements): Arts 9 risk management, 11 documentation, 12 logs, 13 transparency
Read EU AI Act Article 14 (human oversight)
Lab 6a (NovaPay): high-risk checklist for the credit-scoring model: map each of Arts 9-15 to an owner and an artefact
Read the AI Act implementation timeline: ORIGINAL dates
Read Morgan Lewis on the Digital Omnibus: NEW dates (Annex III to 2 Dec 2027, Annex I to 2 Aug 2028); make a two-column date card
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'Understanding and assessing risk'

weeks.theme: Applied deep dive: FRIA/DPIA lab, GDPR and US laws, Mock #2, standards, post-market

tasks.title: Read EU AI Act Article 25 (value chain: when a deployer becomes a provider)
Read EU AI Act Article 27 (fundamental rights impact assessment)
Lab 6b (NovaPay): mini FRIA + DPIA for deploying the CV-screening tool (use the Art 27 and GDPR Art 35 headings; 1 page)
Anki: provider vs deployer vs 'deemed provider'; FRIA vs DPIA
Complete Canada's Algorithmic Impact Assessment tool for the same CV-screening scenario and compare
Read ICO Guidance on AI and data protection: accountability, lawfulness, fairness and transparency sections
Read EDPB Opinion 28/2024 executive summary (model anonymity, legitimate-interest 3-step test)
Read GDPR Article 13 (incl. 'meaningful information about the logic involved')
Course: re-do the II.A quiz questions you missed the first time
Read ICO: 'How do we ensure individual rights in our AI systems?'
Read McDermott: Colorado SB24-205 blocked, replaced by SB26-189 (eff. 1 Jan 2027); keep the developer/deployer duty-of-care concepts
Read Wittliff Cutter: Texas TRAIGA, the Colorado reset and federal preemption (2026)
Read FPF on South Korea's AI Framework (Basic) Act (new in v2.1)
Read EU AI Act Article 50 (transparency: chatbots, synthetic content, deepfakes) and Article 99 penalty tiers
Teach-back: 5-minute voice memo on 'which AI laws apply to NovaPay in the EU and US, and why'
Read the Dec 2025 White House EO on a national AI policy framework (state-law preemption)
FULL MOCK #2: AI Career Pro Mock 2, timed 165 min (target >=70% overall, no domain <65%; >=75% counts toward the booking rule)
Score Mock #2 by domain; update the gap log; pick the two weakest competencies for Week 5
Rest day: no study
Review every Mock #2 item: why each distractor is wrong
Buy the IAPP official AIGP practice exam (~$50-60, price unverified); confirm the store page references BoK v2.1
Read ISMS.online on ISO 42001 Annex A controls (A.2-A.10 objectives)
Lab 7: using the NIST AI RMF to ISO/IEC 42001 crosswalk, build a 1-page table: NIST function -> 42001 clause -> NovaPay artefact
Skim the ISO/IEC 42005 to NIST AI RMF crosswalk
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'Post-market monitoring, information sharing and enforcement'
Read EU AI Act Article 43 (conformity assessment routes) as a release gate
Lab 8 (NovaPay): 1-page monitoring and incident plan for the credit-scoring model (drift trigger, owner, serious-incident reporting, decommissioning)
Course: rewatch the lessons for your two weakest competencies from Mock #2
Week 4 recap: cumulative Anki review (all decks)
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'AI assurance across the risk categories'

weeks.theme: Consolidation and exam week: Mock #3, IAPP official practice exam, go/no-go, exam Tue 27 Oct

tasks.title: FULL MOCK #3: AI Career Pro Mock 3, timed 165 min (target >=75% overall, no domain <65-70%). Block a long evening
Score Mock #3 by domain and compare with Mock #2
Review Mock #3 misses; rewatch the course lessons for the 3 most-missed competencies
Gap closure: redo your weakest NovaPay lab (default Lab 5 vendor questionnaire) using what the mocks taught you
Early go/no-go check on Mocks #2 and #3. If the handbook's reschedule cut-off falls before Sun 25 Oct, decide today
Read AIGP Playbook reference sheets and checklists (impact assessments, vendor review)
Course: take 40 mixed questions from the course bank you haven't seen, timed (~1.5 min each)
Run the OnVUE system check on the exam computer (>=48 h ahead) or confirm the test-centre route; re-read the handbook's ID and room rules
Watch 'Top 3 Tips to Pass Your AIGP Exam on the First Try'
IAPP OFFICIAL AIGP PRACTICE EXAM: timed 165 min, exam conditions (target >=70-75%)
Score the IAPP practice exam by domain

GO/NO-GO: Mocks #2 and #3 both >=75% with no domain <65-70%, AND IAPP practice >=70-75%? Yes: keep Tue 27 Oct. No: reschedule to Tue 10 Nov (if still inside the handbook cut-off) and run the 2-week extension
Optional 20-min Anki pass (due cards only)
Review every IAPP practice-exam miss: note the qualifier (FIRST/BEST/MOST) and the lifecycle stage each item hinged on
Build your one-page cram sheet: AI Act dates (both schedules), penalty tiers, Art 5 bans, Annex III areas, impact-assessment types (DPIA/FRIA/conformity/42005/AEDT audit)
Read the AIGP Playbook exam-day revision sheet (100 essential facts by domain); star any fact you can't explain. Then stop; early night
Prepare: ID matching registration, clear desk/room (OnVUE), alarm, route
Light: re-skim only your cram sheet and the starred facts (max 20 min)
SIT THE AIGP EXAM: 100 Qs, 165 min (+ optional 15-min break; review flagged first-half items BEFORE the break)
